system.description:
A huge, powerful bow that makes mincemeat of regular armor; many older Cainites are trained in archery. (A modern compound bow instead grants only +5 Traits, but drops the Clumsy Negative Trait.)

Negative Traits: Fragile, Clumsy, Heavy

Concealability: None

Damage: Two health levels

Availability: Any

Special Abilities: Armor-Piercing (ignores chain armor); Staking (arrows may stake a vampire if the archer wins or ties two Simple Tests after a successful hit); Destroy Shield (one shot renders a shield useless).
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Rules, Systems and Drama
